prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Bismuth (Bi) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: her own room in a house of her element's kingdom, its walls and furniture built from the element's materials and colours, a mirror and a window
Time of day: dusk — blue hour, lights coming on.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a light linen lounge set — in rich jewel tones such as emerald, sapphire, amethyst or wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — bismuth: a heavy pinkish-silver metal that, melted and cooled, grows stepped square hopper crystals spiralling inward like staircases, its thin oxide skin splitting light into gold, rose, blue and green; gentle for a heavy metal, it soothes upset stomachs and gives makeup its pearly shimmer; it expands as it freezes and is pushed away by magnets; its low-melting alloys seal fire sprinklers; in 2003 it was found to decay, with a half-life over a billion times the age of the universe — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: User selected 2,2,2 and authorized image/data commits and main updates without further confirmation.

observations: 1024x1536, one adult main woman, Japanese painterly anime rendering; face, hair colour and skin treatment follow the selected world reference.
No obvious extra or disconnected arms or legs; hands consistent with the visible framing.
One hand holds a lantern at chest height in her room; bob, eyes and reference skin rendering retained.
